Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on the outer hip, the other raised overhead, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme powerlifter bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
